data.comment:
# Comfy PixVerse V6 Max- Text to Video

Generate videos up to 15 seconds at 1080p from a text prompt with PixVerse V6 Max, the higher-fidelity tier of PixVerse V6, with native audio and multi-shot direction in a single generation. No input files required. Ideal for social ads, product concept clips and short-form storytelling. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_pixverse_v6_max_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Product advertising film for a light grey knit running shoe, three shots. Shot one: side silhouette from a 45 degree angle, camera tracks slowly sideways, seamless light grey gradient backdrop, hard specular highlight on the knit upper, macro depth of field. Shot two: extreme close up of the sole tread pattern, a hard light sweeps from the left across the rubber surface revealing the groove geometry. Shot three: the shoe descends from above into frame and lands on a matte pale stone plinth, a few fine dust particles lift gently at the instant of contact, generous negative space. Seamless gradient backdrop, hard specular light, shallow depth of field, restrained palette, no text, no logo, no people.
